title: Chen Nian's Shadow · Holy Sect Clue
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji pulled the Tianji Record back into his Mental Sea, a cold voice sounded behind him—"Chen Ji, I've been waiting for you." It was Ye Qing's voice, carrying the chilling essence of the Demonic Path, yet hiding a trace of imperceptible gravity.

text.content: The moment the third page of the Tianji Record awakened, Chen Ji saw a new branch of fate—and at the end of one branch stood someone he absolutely should not have seen.

The figure was blurred like through a layer of mist, yet its silhouette was etched into his bones. Disheveled hair hung loose like withered grass, a fragile form suspended by chains in a dark stone chamber, each limb bound by a glowing azure rune chain, each chain deeply embedded into her flesh.

Chen Nian—his sister, missing for five years. Chen Ji felt his heart clenched by an invisible hand, his breath stopping in an instant. He stared fixedly at that hazy illusion, his pupils reflecting his sister's ashen face, dried blood at the corner of her eye, her lips moving as if speaking.

However, in the next instant, the Tianji Record's vision twisted violently, the figure shattering into thousands of fragments of light before reforming—this time, the background was clear. It was a deep abyss-like underground palace, chilling winds howling, the air thick with nauseating blood. The palace dome was covered with dense ancient runes, each one slowly draining the life force from the figure in the chains.

dialogue.content: "Did you find it?" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul voice drifted from the depths of the first page, carrying an imperceptible weight, "That is the 'Heavenly Fate Altar' of the Holy Sect. She has been made the... Heavenly Fate Key."

text.content: Heavenly Fate Key. Chen Ji's fists slowly tightened in his sleeves, his knuckles whitening. In his previous life, he had seen this term recorded in the Holy Sect's forbidden texts—a person of specific bloodline used as a guide to seal the power of Heavenly Secrets divination. She was chosen not for any other reason, but precisely because of the blood bond between her and him.

The Tianji Record flickered again, revealing a new image—a complex seal formation diagram, with four large characters clearly marked at its center: Heavenly Fate Altar. And at the edge of the formation, a faint line of small text: "The method to break the formation lies within the seventh page of the Tianji Record; the key to enter lies within the core of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds."

The seventh page—he had only just awakened the third page, so how would he obtain the seventh? The Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds—that was a place where even Nascent Soul experts never returned. Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing down the surging emotions. He raised his head, his gaze sweeping the surroundings—the mist in the third layer of the secret realm grew thicker, and in the distance, a soft rustling of footsteps was approaching. Someone was coming.

He had to make a choice. Continue pretending to be atrash, quietly lay plans, waiting for the right moment? Or expose some of his strength now, and try to gather more intelligence about the Holy Sect? Each choice led to completely different consequences, and time—he only had a three-hour foresight window, and one hour had already passed.

choice.prompt: Faced with the truth of his sister's imprisonment, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: Suppress his impulse, maintain his waste persona. Seemingly explore the secret realm indifferently while secretly gathering Holy Sect intelligence, waiting for the right moment to act.
choices.visible_reward: Protect persona from being exposed, gain more time to scheme
choices.risk_hint: Sister's situation may worsen at any time

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, forcibly tearing the Tianji Record's vision from his mind. When he opened them again, his gaze had returned to its usual nonchalant calm, even a self-mocking bitter smile on his lips—the exact response a "trash" should have. He muttered "This broken place has nothing" and slowly walked in another direction.

Footsteps approached from the distance—the Xuanwu Sect disciples. Upon seeing Chen Ji, a hint of disdain flickered in their eyes. The leader sneered: "Oh, isn't this thetrash from Tianqing Sect? Still not dead in the third layer?"

choices.description: Deliberately or not display partial strength, attract the attention of other forces within the secret realm, use this to probe the Holy Sect's布局 in the secret realm, seek possibilities to approach the forbidden grounds.
choices.visible_reward: May obtain key Holy Sect intelligence

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze flickered, and he made a dangerous decision. He deliberately slowed his pace, letting the Xuanwu Sect disciples catch up, then "inadvertently" released a breath of aura that no Servant Disciple should possess—a remnant sword intent from his past life, enough to make perceptive people notice the anomaly.

dialogue.content: As expected, the leader's smile froze on his face, his eyes flashing: "Interesting... Tianqing Sect'strash, truly not simple." Yet he did not attack immediately, instead giving Chen Ji a meaningful look, "Are you looking for something? Or perhaps... someone?"

choices.text: Seek Ye Qing, obtain Holy Sect internal intelligence
choices.description: Immediately contact Demon Path Saintess Ye Qing. Her demonic mist can conceal the Tianji Record's aura, and she may hold partial intelligence on the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds. The risk is exposing weakness, but the potential gain is greater.
choices.visible_reward: May obtain detailed Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds intelligence

text.content: Chen Ji made his decision. From his bosom, he took out a jade talisman carved with black runes—the contact token Ye Qing had left him. He injected a wisp of divine sense into it, then crushed it. The jade talisman turned into a wisp of black smoke, dissipating into the mist.

A moment later, the surrounding mist suddenly became strange, as if pulled by some force, slowly gathering around Chen Ji. A faint ethereal fragrance permeated the air—that was Ye Qing's unique scent—she had arrived.

No matter which path he chose, Chen Ji clearly knew one thing—he could no longer treat Chen Nian's existence as a distant regret like before. Heavenly Fate Key, these four characters were branded into his soul like a branding iron, each chain constantly reminding him: his sister was paying for him with her life, bearing some terrible price.

Time passed little by little. Chen Ji adjusted his breathing, thoroughly suppressing the surging emotions into the deepest part of his heart. His face resumed that lazy and timid expression, exactly what the "trash Servant" that everyone in Tianqing Sect knew should look like. Yet his divine sense was constantly deducing various possibilities—if he chose the first path, he would need at least three months to arrange things while obtaining Holy Sect intelligence without exposure.

The second path carried greater risk, but the returns were more direct—as long as he could create enough disturbance in the secret realm, he might attract the Holy Sect's attention and steal key intelligence from them. The price was possibly completely exposing his true strength, causing that old fox Ling Yuan to be alerted in advance.

As for the third path... Ye Qing. His understanding of this Demon Path Saintess was limited, but she gave him a strange feeling—she was not a simple aggressor, more like a chess piece caught in fate's web. If he could make her stand on his side, her demonic mist would become his greatest asset.

At this moment, the mist in the secret realm suddenly churned violently. A chilling coldness attacked from behind, carrying the Demonic Path's unique Yin-cold aura. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—it was coming far faster than expected. Ye Qing had said she would not respond this quickly unless there was an emergency.

"Chen Ji, I've been waiting for you." That voice was cold as the Nine Nether Abyss, yet hiding an imperceptible gravity. Chen Ji turned sharply, facing deep ink-black eyes—Ye Qing stood three zhang away, her face covered by black纱, form flickering in the mist, surrounded by eerie black mist.

dialogue.content: "What did you see?" Ye Qing's voice was unnaturally calm, "I sensed a Heavenly Fate fluctuation—you just used the Tianji Record, and... saw something you shouldn't have." Her gaze was sharp as a blade, as if trying to see through Chen Ji entirely, "Something that makes you take such a risk wouldn't be a simple fortune. Speak, who are you looking for?"

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing, only quietly looking at her. Ye Qing seemed in no hurry, simply waiting silently. After a moment, Chen Ji slowly spoke, his voicecalm得没有一丝波澜: "If I said it's my sister, would you believe me?"

Ye Qing's form stiffened slightly. She stared into Chen Ji's eyes, seemingly judging the truth of his words. After a long while, she suddenly laughed lightly, that laugh sounding particularly eerie in the silent secret realm: "Chen Ji, you know what? On my way here, I saw a similar scene—my sister, imprisoned somewhere in the Holy Sect."

A flash of异色 appeared in Chen Ji's eyes. So that was it—Ye Qing's willingness to cooperate with him was not only because of that prophecy, but because they shared similar circumstances. Two people caught in fate's grip, two people both searching for loved ones, finally found their intersecting point on the chaotic chessboard of this world.

dialogue.content: "I have intelligence on the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds." Ye Qing's voice was low and firm, "As an exchange, I want you to do me a favor—take me into the core of the forbidden grounds together." She paused, a cold light flickering in her eyes, "I have a way to get us in, but we need to cooperate—do you dare?"

choice.prompt: Ye Qing proposed cooperation, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Formally ally with Ye Qing, jointly plan to enter the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds. Their goals align perfectly, and cooperation may create miracles.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds intelligence, unlock new plotline
choices.risk_hint: Does Ye Qing have other motives behind her?

dialogue.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then slowly nodded: "Alright." His voice was calm, yet carrying undeniable resolve, "But I must state clearly—if your plan harms those close to me, I won't hesitate to make enemies of the Demonic Path."

Ye Qing laughed lightly, seemingly unconcerned by such a threat: "Relax, I seek your cooperation because we share a common enemy." She took out a jade slip from her sleeve, handing it to Chen Ji, "This is the outer perimeter layout of the forbidden grounds. Information on the core area... after you show sufficient sincerity, I will tell you myself."

choices.description: Ye Qing's proposal was tempting, but blindly trusting someone from the Demonic Path was too risky. Demand she provide more core intelligence first, then decide whether to cooperate.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not reach for the jade slip, only looking at Ye Qing calmly: "Saintess Ye, cooperation requires equality. You want me to show sufficient sincerity, but where is yours? One outer perimeter layout map, and you expect me to hand over the secrets of the Tianji Record?"

A hint of admiration flashed in Ye Qing's eyes. She retrieved the jade slip, a meaningful arc curving at the corner of her lips: "Interesting, worthy of being chosen by the Tianji Record." She took out another jet-black token, "This is an internal identity token of the Holy Sect—captured by my people. With it, you can enter the outer perimeter of the forbidden grounds as a peripheral Holy Sect disciple."

text.content: The moment the token entered his hand, Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill spread from his fingertips throughout his entire body. That was the Holy Sect's unique aura—exactly the same as what he had seen in the Tianji Record's vision. He tucked the token into his chest, his gaze falling on Ye Qing once more. This time, he looked more carefully—her face beneath the black纱 was indiscernible, but the emotions hidden in those eyes made him faintly feel a sense of familiarity.

It was the same despair and unwillingness, the tenacity of struggling despite being caught in fate's web. He suddenly remembered what Mo Xiansheng had once said—"There are so many chess pieces in this world, but those who truly break free from the board are often those who dare to face their own weaknesses."

"Three days later, before the secret realm closes, we meet here." Ye Qing's voice broke his reverie, "At that time, I will tell you the location of the forbidden grounds' core entrance. But before then—" her voice suddenly dropped, "Be careful of the people from Tianqing Sect. Someone is watching you."

The words fell, and Ye Qing's form had already dissolved like dust into the mist, as if she had never appeared. Chen Ji stood alone, fingers rubbing the token in his chest, his mind filled with countless thoughts. Three days of time—he needed to prepare thoroughly—continue maintaining thetrash persona, not letting Ling Yuan sense anything amiss; at the same time, secretly arrange things, laying groundwork for the upcoming Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds expedition.

In the distance, a刺目的 beam of light suddenly cracked across the secret realm's dome—the sign that the secret realm was about to close. Chen Ji took a deep breath, taking one last look at the lingering image in the Tianji Record—Chen Nian's form remained blurred, but this time, that blurred outline seemed clearer by a fraction. He knew, this was only the beginning. The true chess game was just beginning to unfold.

Just as Chen Ji pulled the Tianji Record back into his Mental Sea, a cold voice sounded behind him—"Chen Ji, I've been waiting for you." It was Ye Qing's voice, carrying the chilling essence of the Demonic Path, yet hiding a trace of imperceptible gravity.
